pa_dashboards.description: Personal work queue dashboard for case agents - shows your assigned open cases, your overdue tasks, and the status distribution of your own case portfolio. All three widgets are scoped to the viewing user: the Case Count by Status donut was re-scoped for QA finding F5, because report execution does not apply row-level read ACLs and an unfiltered aggregate disclosed the status distribution of cases the agent cannot open. The portfolio-wide aggregates stay on the Manager View per AAP Section 0.4.4.
pa_dashboards.name: x_casemgmt_agent_workspace
